selector.rationale: Basal cell carcinoma best explains the presence of firm, painless nodular lesions with central ulceration and crusting, and dermoscopy findings of arborizing telangiectasias and peripheral pigment, with no strong contradictions.

rejected.label: Cutaneous leishmaniasis
rejected.why: Lack of systemic symptoms and specific dermoscopic features

rejected.label: Sporotrichosis
rejected.why: No clear evidence of lymphocutaneous spread or sportrichoid pattern

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: Less specific dermoscopic features and lower score

rejected.label: Cryptococcosis
rejected.why: Although intracellular yeasts were identified, the clinical presentation and dermoscopy are more consistent with basal cell carcinoma
